headline: Godrej Industries Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Godrej Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of Key Information Document for issue of up to 75,000 Rated, Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating up to Rs. 750 Crore on…
detail: General Updates - Godrej Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of Key Information Document for issue of up to 75,000 Rated, Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating up to Rs. 750 Crore on Private Placement Basis.
